Technical & price structure: In plain terms: gold pays nothing and has no cash flows, so its value rests on the published analyst consensus (a Reuters poll of 30 analysts centres on ~$4,800 for 2026) and the strongest structural demand in its modern history — record 2025 demand above 5,000 tonnes, central banks buying 863 tonnes, and gold now the largest reserve asset by value. Spot ~$3,990 sits about 5% below the $4,200–5,000 consensus zone after a ~29% correction. The near-term cap is rising real rates and a firm dollar; the floor is the structural central-bank bid.
